main_body: wooden gong frame with hanging brass gong
top_band: light warm brown horizontal crossbeam top surface on rows 3-5 (and pedestal base tops on rows 26-28)
evidence: The horizontal crossbeam clearly shows a 3-row light brown top surface (rows 3-5) above its shaded front face (rows 6-7), and the bottom pedestal blocks likewise show 3-row top surfaces (rows 26-28) above their dark vertical front faces (rows 29-31). The pillars and gong are recessed under the overhanging beam.

style.evidence: Both the wood frame and the brass gong use 5-6 distinct value steps with rich concentric metallic shading on the gong, wood grain variation on the posts/beam, and dark brown/ochre material-toned outlines matching the Beodeul references.
